recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further editing would either duplicate the existing applied resolution or broaden the wording beyond the approved tracker decision.
issue_request: FHIR-47249 was an Applied, Persuasive with Modification OO change request for R6 asking ServiceRequest.code to explain when a reference to PlanDefinition should be used, because the reporter understood ActivityDefinition use but not how PlanDefinition relates to a service.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was added to the build in PR commit cd2d365599d44834a31394625a8e6f71145db5d9. The underlying implementation commit 8483d7e9b6af0cd96c16f7bfc58152dadf583f13 added the approved PlanDefinition sentence to source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml.
additional_context: ServiceRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/servicerequest/structuredefinition-ServiceRequest.xml is in current build scope. The current ServiceRequest.code element remains a CodeableReference targeting ActivityDefinition and PlanDefinition, reflecting earlier FHIR-33075 work that changed the datatype. Community and Confluence searches found the October 2024 OO block-vote reference and order-set background discussion, but no conflicting later decision requiring a different source change.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative ServiceRequest source already contains the approved clarification: PlanDefinition may be used to group multiple activities together, such as an order set that is part of a plan.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published ServiceRequest issue that changed ServiceRequest.code to CodeableReference(ActivityDefinition|PlanDefinition), providing background for why FHIR-47249 only needed explanatory comment text.
